metadata.artifact_purpose: Expert comparison for downstream AI review and profile refinement

sources_compared.label: LinkedIn Profile Update Guide — Holistic Leadership
LinkedIn Profile Update Guide — Healthcare & Domain Expertise

executive_summary.overall_conclusion: Both proposed guides are materially stronger than the current profile, but neither should be used unchanged. The strongest result is a hybrid profile that uses Holistic Leadership as the narrative foundation and selectively merges the best healthcare / regulated-industry / search-oriented language from Healthcare & Domain Expertise.

strengths: Strong long-term consulting and leadership progression
Real quantified business outcomes across multiple firms
Credible breadth across architecture, governance, engineering, and advisory
Existing recommendations support strategic thinking and communication range
weaknesses: Headline is too generic and undersells differentiation
About section reads more like a broad analytics consultant than a senior enterprise data platform architect
Skills are not optimized for future role search
Not as search-optimized for healthcare / regulated roles
Agentic AI is slightly overemphasized relative to proven body of work
Could be perceived as leadership-first and domain-second

strengths: Best healthcare / PBM / regulated-industry keyword coverage
Strong alignment to recent enterprise data lakehouse recommendation themes
Best AHEAD framing for recent domain work
weaknesses: Can narrow perceived market too much
Less distinctive as a leadership brand
Slightly denser and more technical in tone
healthcare_domain.expert_verdict: Best search and domain overlay, not the best standalone profile

headline.recommended_candidate: Data Platform Architect & Practice Builder | Healthcare, PBM & Regulated Industries | Canonical Data Models | AWS, Azure, GCP | Coach & Servant-Leader
reasoning: Adds healthcare and regulated-industry search value
Includes canonical data models as a distinctive technical keyword
Signals leadership without losing architecture credibility

about.recommended_opening_candidate: I build cloud-native data platforms for healthcare, regulated, and enterprise environments — and the teams that can own them after I leave. Over 20+ years, I've led the design of event-driven, configuration-driven platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, using canonical data models and reusable ingestion patterns to turn complex source landscapes into trusted data products.
must_include: healthcare or regulated environment relevance within first two sentences
ERP / CRM / third-party mappings into canonical models

skills.guidance: Balance broad credibility skills with targeted role-search signals; do not overcorrect into healthcare-only language.

validation_issues.action_required: Verify exact degree field before publishing

dusan_recommendation_supported_themes: data quality, governance, and analytics impact
patrick_recommendation_supported_themes: ability to explain complex concepts to senior leaders and junior engineers
recommendation_alignment.interpretation: Dusan supports the healthcare/domain overlay. Patrick supports the leadership/coaching/communication layer. Together they reinforce the hybrid recommendation.

final_verdict.one_sentence_conclusion: Do not keep the current profile, do not publish either proposed guide unchanged, and do publish a hybrid that uses Holistic Leadership as the base and Healthcare & Domain Expertise as the search and domain-credibility overlay.

downstream_ai_action_plan: Treat Holistic Leadership as the narrative base
Pull healthcare / regulated / PBM / claims / canonical-data-model keywords into the headline and first quarter of the About section
Rebuild AHEAD using the Healthcare draft plus one or two Holistic leadership bullets
Rebuild PwC as a balanced merge of scale, architecture, coaching, and productization
Preserve quantified wins from the current profile wherever credible
Resolve date and degree-field conflicts before publishing
Reorder skills for search intent and visible credibility
Keep AI positioning concise and credible
